Name: Wave Grabbler (Wave-Sec)
Source: Lyres Guide to Risk and Reward
Information:
A vehicle initially designed to be the city’s primary means of defense, but then adapted to be a recreational transportation vehicle for citizens who could afford them (or to be lent to organizations who would make use of them). They are, all at once, a military vehicle, a form of public transportation, and a heavy-duty labor implement. They use magnetic technology to adhere to metal surfaces and produce an instantaneous vacuum seal between themselves and surfaces they walk upon, allowing them to move across all dimensions without needing to adjust. This makes them incredibly useful when traveling across the walls separating the many Wards of the Rising Peak. Cables and arches are built between many areas specifically for these spider-like constructs to easily move across them.

Inside the back of the grabbler is enough space for about 10 regular-sized creatures across several layers oriented in a rotating fashion, similar to a rotating wheel that allows for separation and storage of its contents, accompanied by “walking space” below it.

• “I’m going to ride in a spider robot one day. Mark my words.
No, I’m going to DRIVE one.
NO! I’m going to own one!”

Additional Sections.title: Wave Grabbler (Wave-Sec) Stations
Additional Sections.intro: The Wave-Sec Wave Grappler has a an additional station that can be manned by a creature of an appropriate size, and while present there they can take the effects listed:

entries.name: Combat Support
entries.description: This external station can be used to man the grabbler’s artillery and provide additional coordination in combat conditions.

actions.name: Attack
actions.description: The grabbler makes a single Slam or Bolt Chain attack against a target the station operator chooses. This attack is calculated as if the station operator was a pilot.

actions.name: Move
actions.description: The grabbler moves up to half its movement speed immediately, directed by the station operator.

bonus_actions.name: Breakthrough
bonus_actions.description: If the grabbler is being grappled, restrained, or is suffering from an effect requiring a Strength check or save to end/escape from, it can attempt to make that check immediately. If it succeeds, the effect ends as though the check/save were succeeded and follows the effect’s terms for ending as a success.

reactions.name: Boost Effort
reactions.description: When the gabbler makes an attack and misses, the operator at this station may use their reaction to roll a d20 and may choose to use it in place of the attack’s d20 result, possibly changing the outcome.

reactions.name: Opportunity Attack
reactions.description: The creature manning this station can use their reaction to have the grabbler make an opportunity attack when one would be provoked. This does not use the grabbler’s reaction.

Stat Blocks.title: Wave Grabbler (Wave-Sec)
languages: understands Common and the languages of its creator, but doesn’t speak

traits.name: Headlights
traits.description: The construct can create a 30-foot-cone of bright light ahead of it, from which dim light extends an additional 30 feet. It can turn this light on or off at will on its turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The construct makes two Bolt Chain Turret attacks and one Slam attack.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (3d12 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Bolt Chain Turret
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) lightning damage.

actions.name: Trample
actions.description: The construct moves up to half its movement speed in a straight line, trampling over any creatures in those spaces as it does. Each creature it enters the space of must succeed a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 20 (3d12) bludgeoning damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. Medium-sized or smaller creatures who succeed this save (or would end their turn in the construct’s space) move into the nearest unoccupied space outside the construct’s path. If a Huge or larger creature succeeds their save, the construct stops moving immediately without entering their space. Creatures who fail are pushed into the nearest unoccupied space outside the construct’s path and fall prone.

bonus_actions.name: Hydraulic Leap (Recharge 5-6)
bonus_actions.description: The construct leaps to a space within its movement speed that it can occupy. Creatures in the space it lands in are treated as if hit by its Trample action, but if the construct fails to push them out of its space the construct falls prone in that space instead. This leap causes the construct to soar up to half as high as it moves horizontally, allowing it to move above other creatures. This does not provoke opportunity attacks.

reactions.name: Orientation Matrix
reactions.description: When the construct would take falling damage or fall prone, it can use its reaction to reduce the falling damage to half and/or immediately stand upright.
